contracts: (The S20 exact-cover check reports forward and reverse coverage for every Atomic Obligation-to-witness relationship and no orphan witness node.) AND (The planned selector reports zero orphan nodes across every required node type and fails for an orphan or one-way relationship.)
selector_intents: Run the planned Exact Cover negative selector with a one-directional relationship and require validation failure.
Run the planned Exact Cover negative selector with an orphan Atomic Obligation, assertion, selector, command, witness, or runtime-evidence node and require validation failure.
The S20 test must fail when forward Atomic Obligation coverage lacks matching reverse witness coverage or a witness link is orphaned.
